subject: Matemática
description_pt: Ler, interpretar e comparar dados apresentados em tabelas de dupla entrada, gráficos de barras ou de colunas, envolvendo resultados de pesquisas significativas, utilizando termos como maior e menor frequência, apropriando-se desse tipo de linguagem para compreender aspectos da realidade sociocultural significativos.

components.description_pt: Ler e interpretar dados apresentados em tabelas de dupla entrada, gráficos de barras ou colunas
components.description_en: Read and interpret data presented in two-way tables, bar graphs, or column graphs

components.description_pt: Comparar conjuntos de dados utilizando termos como maior frequência e menor frequência
components.description_en: Compare data sets using terms such as greater frequency and lesser frequency
components.cc_component_description: Interpret differences in different data sets in context, including differences due to possible effects of outliers

components.description_pt: Aplicar linguagem matemática de gráficos e tabelas para compreender aspectos da realidade sociocultural
components.description_en: Apply mathematical language from graphs and tables to understand aspects of sociocultural reality

cc_matches.description: Interpret differences in shape, center, and spread in the context of the data sets, accounting for possible effects of extreme data points (outliers).

Understand that patterns of association can also be seen in bivariate categorical data by displaying frequencies and relative frequencies in a two-way table. Construct and interpret a two-way table summarizing data on two categorical variables collected from the same subjects. Use relative frequencies calculated for rows or columns to describe possible association between the two variables. *For example, collect data from students in your class on whether or not they have a curfew on school nights and whether or not they have assigned chores at home. Is there evidence that those who have a curfew also tend to have chores?*
